proves.claim: an offer through underBoardWriteLock() appends one row to the machine board-writes.jsonl naming its command, pid and outcome, committed or rolled back

cli.io-landing-pull.offer-lock-records-h.why: Without it a landing offer's write lock could stall every board writer with no recorded holder, as it did for 347 s on 18 Nov.

proves.claim: while the offer holds the lock the board's write-holders folder has its marker, and it is gone after commit or rollback

cli.io-landing-pull.offer-lock-marks-hol.why: Without it a busy writer could not name the landing offer holding the lock.
